## [1.1.3](https://github.com/steeepaaaan/pdalife-morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.2...v1.1.3) (2026-10-27)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Fix compilation errors in NeutralizePdalifeJniOnLoadPatch.kt ([bbd033d](https://github.com/steeepaaaan/pdalife-morphe-patches/commit/bbd033d01e91f5a0f01d3f2d75f8c88597922f60))

patches.name: Neutralize PDALIFE JNI_OnLoad (universal)
patches.description: Universal patch: Patches libPDALIFE.so's JNI_OnLoad to return immediately without installing hooks. Prevents PDALIFE banner/toast from being set up.

patches.name: Remove PDALIFE Application from manifest
patches.description: Removes android:name="com.pdalife.PdaApplication" from AndroidManifest.xml so the PDALIFE injector never runs.

patches.name: Remove PDALIFE config assets
patches.description: Deletes assets/PDALIFE.conf and assets/PDALIFE.bin from the APK. Keeps libPDALIFE.so so native onCreate methods resolve.
